text: The owned cleanup adds the gtest Rust 2021 edition and removes plugin flags, but does not implement minimum supported Rust version propagation. Its original gkrust generator template still emits plugin=false. Accepted later manifests use the 2024 edition and inherit rust-version from the workspace, while the comm generator reads the upstream workspace value and passes it to rendering. Keep generator-owned output and later propagation separate from this manual cleanup. No generator run, pinned upstream minimum or toolchain compatibility is established here.
title: The Rust cleanup leaves generated minimum-version propagation to a later change
